outcomes.text: Students develop knowledge of language structure alongside computational analysis.
The catalog identifies computational linguistics, natural language processing and machine learning as preparation areas.

courses.name: Introduction to Program Design and Implementation
Advanced Programming with Data
courses.description: Develops robust software architectures and data pipelines using substantial datasets.
courses.prerequisites: CS 2100 with a minimum grade of D- or DS 2500 with a minimum grade of D-

courses.name: Mathematical Foundations of Artificial Intelligence
courses.description: Studies the mathematical basis of AI through linear algebra, probability and computational exercises.
courses.prerequisites: CS 2100 with a minimum grade of D- or CIS 201M with a minimum grade of D- or CS 2510 with a minimum grade of D- or DS 2500 with a minimum grade of D-

courses.name: Information Presentation and Visualization
courses.description: Studies how to design, implement and evaluate visual representations of data.
courses.prerequisites: CS 2100 with a minimum grade of D- or CIS 201M with a minimum grade of D- or CS 2510 with a minimum grade of D- or DS 2500 with a minimum grade of D-

courses.name: Large-Scale Information Storage and Retrieval
courses.description: Studies scalable data storage, distributed databases and retrieval methods.
courses.prerequisites: ( CS 3100 with a minimum grade of D- or CIS 310M with a minimum grade of D- or CS 3500 with a minimum grade of D- or DS 3500 with a minimum grade of D- ); CS 3200 with a minimum grade of D-

courses.name: Machine Learning
courses.description: Introduces predictive modeling and major supervised and unsupervised learning methods.
courses.prerequisites: DS 3000 with a minimum grade of D- or CIS 250M with a minimum grade of D- or ( MATH 2331 with a minimum grade of D- ; MATH 3081 with a minimum grade of D- )

courses.name: Advanced Machine Learning
courses.description: Studies advanced learning methods and their mathematical and computational foundations.
courses.prerequisites: DS 4400 with a minimum grade of D-

courses.name: Fundamentals of Digital Design and Computer Organization
Digital, Analytics, Technology, and Automation Research Practicum
Introduction to Linguistics
courses.description: Surveys language science, including speech sounds, word and sentence structure, and meaning.

courses.name: Linguistic Analysis
courses.description: Develops linguistic analysis through a sustained investigation of a language.
courses.prerequisites: LING 1449 with a minimum grade of D- or LING 1150 with a minimum grade of D-

courses.name: Language and Culture
courses.description: Examines how language interacts with culture and social life.
courses.prerequisites: ( LING 1449 with a minimum grade of D- or ENGL 1150 with a minimum grade of D- or LING 1150 with a minimum grade of D- ); (ENGL 1102 with a minimum grade of C or ENGL 1111 with a minimum grade of C or ENGW 1102 with a minimum grade of C or ENGW 1111 with a minimum grade of C or WRIT 201M with a minimum grade of C or ENGW 1113 with a minimum grade of C or ENGW 1114 with a minimum grade of C )

courses.name: Phonetics
courses.description: Studies speech production, speech acoustics and speech perception.
courses.prerequisites: LING 2350 with a minimum grade of D-

courses.name: Phonology
courses.description: Studies how languages organize and represent their sound systems.
courses.prerequisites: LING 2350 with a minimum grade of D-

courses.name: Morphology
courses.description: Analyzes word structure and morphological patterns and theories.
courses.prerequisites: LING 2350 with a minimum grade of D-

courses.name: Syntax
courses.description: Introduces syntactic theory and evidence-based analysis of sentence structure.
courses.prerequisites: LING 2350 with a minimum grade of D-

courses.name: Semantics
courses.description: Examines linguistic meaning in words, sentence structure and language use.
courses.prerequisites: LING 1449 with a minimum grade of D- or LING 1150 with a minimum grade of D-

courses.name: Research Seminar in Linguistics
courses.description: Combines individual faculty-guided research with group discussion of methods and findings.

courses.name: Directed Study Research
courses.description: Provides individual research under faculty supervision, with arrangements made before registration.

courses.name: Seminar in Linguistics
courses.description: Explores a selected issue in contemporary linguistic research.
courses.prerequisites: LING 2350 with a minimum grade of D-; Additional course-description condition: either two 3000-level LING courses or one 3000-level LING course and permission of instructor.
